title: Final speed in E-field
description: Essential: The student must correctly state the speed upon entering the magnetic field as 2v₀, derived from the work-energy theorem.

title: Final magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: The student must correctly state the magnitude of the magnetic induction as 3mv₀/(qd).

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem (or kinematics) to relate the electric field work to the change in kinetic energy.

title: Angle at magnetic field entry
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the angle (e.g., π/3) the velocity makes with the x-axis upon entering the magnetic field using kinematics in the electric field.

title: Geometry of circular motion
description: Important: The solution must establish the geometric relationship (r + r cosθ = d) between the circular path radius, the entry angle, and the region width d.

title: Lorentz force centripetal condition
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion (qvB = mv²/r) in the magnetic field.

title: Incorrect electric field kinematics
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly treats motion in the electric field (e.g., wrong time, displacement, or velocity components).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize errors in vector direction, such as misapplying the right-hand rule or misplacing the center of the circular arc.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award if the student explicitly verifies the dimensional consistency of their final expression for B.
